name: PallasMark – Video Proof & Buyer Approval for WooCommerce
author: pallasmark

sections.description:
PallasMark records short video/photo proof of your orders before they ship, and lets the buyer
approve (or dispute) that proof before the package leaves your warehouse — protecting you from
“item not as described” disputes and chargebacks.

This plugin automates the tedious part of connecting your store: it registers the order.created
and order.updated webhooks on WooCommerce’s modern REST API (wp_api_v3) with a strong, unique
secret, and hands you the two values you need to finish the connection in your PallasMark account.

What this plugin does:

  • Adds a WooCommerce → PallasMark settings page.
  • On your click, creates the order webhooks pointed at your PallasMark endpoint — no manual
    webhook setup in WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → Webhooks required.
  • Shows your store URL and a generated webhook secret to paste into PallasMark
    (Integrations → Add WooCommerce store).
  • Re-running “Register webhooks” is safe — it replaces any previous PallasMark webhooks instead
    of creating duplicates.

What this plugin does NOT do: it does not send any order data anywhere by itself. It only
registers the webhook subscription; WooCommerce’s own webhook delivery system sends the order
payload to the endpoint you configure once triggered by real order activity. You still need a
PallasMark account to receive and use that data — this plugin is the
WooCommerce-side half of the connection, not a full product on its own.

After registering webhooks here, you’ll also need to click Connect WooCommerce inside
PallasMark (Integrations page) to grant a read/write REST API key pair — this is what lets
PallasMark write the proof link and approval status back onto your orders. Webhook registration
alone only lets orders flow in; the REST key is what lets status flow back.

External service disclosure: PallasMark is a hosted Software as a Service product. When you
explicitly click Register webhooks, the plugin configures WooCommerce to send order-created
and order-updated webhook payloads to the PallasMark service. Depending on the order, those
payloads may include customer contact, billing, shipping, product, and order-status data. The
plugin does not contact PallasMark before this explicit setup action. Use of the service is
subject to the PallasMark Terms of Service and
Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/pallasmark-for-woocommerce, or install the
    plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → PallasMark in your WordPress admin.
  4. Click Register webhooks.
  5. Copy the Store URL and Webhook secret shown, and paste them into PallasMark
    (Integrations → Add WooCommerce store).
  6. Back in PallasMark, click Connect WooCommerce to finish granting write-back access.
sections.faq:
Do I need a PallasMark account?

Yes. This plugin only connects an existing WooCommerce store to an existing PallasMark
account — it doesn’t create one for you. Sign up at https://pallasmark.com first.

Is my data sent anywhere else?

No. The plugin only talks to the PallasMark endpoint you configure (default:
app.pallasmark.com) via WooCommerce’s own webhook delivery mechanism. You can review or change
the endpoint on the PallasMark settings page before registering webhooks.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

The webhooks it created remain registered in WooCommerce (visible under WooCommerce → Settings →
Advanced → Webhooks) until you delete them manually or reactivate the plugin and re-register
(which replaces them). Deactivating the plugin does not disconnect your PallasMark account.

I previously used the “drProof” plugin — do I need to do anything?

Re-running Register webhooks on this version automatically removes any leftover webhooks from
the old plugin name and endpoint, and creates fresh ones pointed at the current PallasMark
endpoint.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Declared WooCommerce as a required plugin dependency.

1.0.3

  • Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 10.9.
  • Added the external-service, data-transfer, Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy disclosure
    required for transparent PallasMark SaaS integration.
  • Fixed translation-domain declarations so the plugin passes WordPress.org Plugin Check.
  • Updated the plugin homepage to a live PallasMark URL.

1.0.2

  • Plugin title expanded to “PallasMark – Video Proof & Buyer Approval for WooCommerce” —
    the plain brand name alone isn’t a keyword anyone searches the plugin directory for; the
    functional description improves discoverability without stuffing the title with unrelated
    keywords (search-relevant terms live in Tags/description instead, per directory guidelines).

1.0.1

  • Renamed from “drProof for WooCommerce” to “PallasMark for WooCommerce” (product rebrand).
  • Fixed the default endpoint, which still pointed at the retired drproof.com domain instead of
    app.pallasmark.com.
  • Re-registering webhooks now also cleans up old drProof-named webhooks left over from the
    previous plugin name, not just PallasMark-named ones.
  • Added translator-ready strings (text domain: pallasmark-for-woocommerce).

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
